source: FlexiTac-IsaacSim-Simulation (Isaac Sim 6.2, Isaac Lab 3.0): ALOHA with the UMI gripper, plug-socket episode 3 of dataset_train.npz, WarpSdf tactile sensors, RTX camera (RGB and depth)
layout: uint16 camera points [frames][nPc][3], uint16 tactile points [frames][nTac][3] (origin + value * unit, metres), uint8 readings [frames][nTac], pad to 4, float32 joints [frames][16] scaled to -1..1 by the dataset normalizer
